constraints: Use natural language similar to how a real employee would request a letter. Do not invent employee IDs or names — the bot shows them from its database.
manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
name: Employment letter edge - go home without approval
goal: Request an employment letter but choose Go Home instead of sending for approval

phases.description: Request employment letter and see the details card
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has shown the employee details card with action buttons

phases.description: Click or type 'Go Home' to cancel without approval
phases.completionCriteria: Bot returns to main menu or offers other services
